# BLE/mesh acceptance boundaries

This maps each original correction separately. Test presence below is not a
claim that its current head passed hosted CI. Inspect the required job logs
before updating the audit ledger. The physical generator is
`manual/ble-mesh-rehearsal.py` under `.github/regression-coverage`.

| Audit | Original correction and existing software evidence | Remaining physical acceptance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2527 | `9d04e5927da594d181c1f56412308495f37c1a84`: a definite controller rejection is a safe interval fallback, unlike uncertain command submission/completion. `interval_barrier_linux_test.go` covers the response matrix. The new `TestBLEControllerOutcomePreservesAuthenticatedTraffic` runs production provider/TLS/hello/echo, with syscall-only HCI outcomes and a no-fallback control. | Original Realtek 13d3:3549 firmware emits 0x0c and the SAME live ACL/CoC subsequently carries authenticated traffic; no replacement connection or alternate LAN route. No simulated HCI result qualifies hardware. |
| 2524 | Original merge `a1ab1d0f355f6cdc77cdb43d96de0f4acfeb0c79`: keep a slow TLS gateway lease alive across reconciliation instead of withdrawing it. `lease_radio_test.go` has real TLS over delayed/lossy in-memory streams and real heartbeat exchange; `TestControllerKeepsPendingGatewayLeaseAcrossSteps` tests controller state with a fake policy. The new namespace journey combines actual Controller, TCP/TLS, lease ownership, kernel tunnel/NAT and HTTP/DNS/withdrawal, with a 16s read hold and pending-withdrawal control. | Qualified actual BLE handshake exceeds15s on one connection, finishes before its unchanged60s handshake bound, then forwards exact Internet data/DNS through the donor and survives heartbeats. Generated delay is not RF evidence. |
| 2576 | `6990052aa1cc3fa41a3de69a7af07ae31118edcf` (duplicate cherry-pick `228100a291c097561d8acf92a3bc0f6f4cf50f27`): native TLS follows carrier selection and owns listener attachments. `TestNormalNativeTLSListenerAttachmentAndDrain` uses real TLS/node/TUN registration and checks context cancellation and listener-close cleanup. `TestNormalNativeTLSLANDialsLitePeer` exercises native LAN discovery/dial. `TestBLECrossedTLSConnectionsRetireOnlyLosingStream` runs actual crossed provider TLS/hello. Existing audit2676 `TestOperatorColdFailureRecoversWithSpareCarrierTraffic` supplies actual fast/standby application-traffic recovery. | Actual native Lite/BlueZ radios and physical Ethernet transitions; observe crossed attempts, selected forwarding/standby ownership, listener lifecycle and repeated management traffic. Current spare-carrier behavior must not be mistaken for a leaked loser. |
| 2669 | Merge `984815b4393be13f58d0bdba154e5f36e9f714ea`: automatic discovered carriers/selected organization replace obsolete pinned-router recipes; operator stream attachment uses cached issuers correctly. `TestAutomaticRouterWithCachedForeignIssuers`, `operator_recipe*_test.go`, `TestOperatorBrokerLegacyPinnedRecipeUsesDiscovery`, and `TestOperatorAdjacentLiteUsesSignedNativeEndpoint` cover these boundaries. `TestOperatorNativeProcessRestartPreservesExplicitDisconnect` uses fresh native processes, durable intent, real authenticated traffic and IPC, but supplies discovery from loopback. | Native macOS CoreBluetooth discovery/permission and actual C5 PSRAM entry after broker restart, matching selected tenant and independently verified device identity. Loopback discovery is not native radio proof. |
| 2603 | `daba2c128a4378e8c0ed7b04b075e1bfe7150c81`: serialize profile changes with mesh-link tuning and read current policy after admission. `TestMeshLinkTuneReadsPolicyAfterControllerAdmission` and `TestLateCodedLinkAdmissionObservesCompletedNormalProfile` provide controlled concurrent barriers. Other controller tests cover real command encoding, PHY/readback refusal, default/legacy behavior and power unknown values. | At least one captured real BlueZ/controller link-tune overlap with a profile change, final policy and observed PHY agreement, real traffic, and explicit numeric/default power outcomes. Requested coding/power without readback cannot prove physical state. |

The existing 1903 physical GATT procedure is reused for ownership and peripheral
identity conventions only. It explicitly excludes these L2CAP/mesh/profile cases.
No physical result or complete original-failure sensitivity is inferred from
source tests. Unavailable qualified RF delay, refusal, overlapping operations or
safe historical control remains pending in the generated acceptance record.
